title: Dungeon Battle Royale
titleRomaji: Dungeon Battle Royale: Maou ni Natta node Sekai Touitsu wo Mezashimasu
titleNative: ダンジョンバトルロワイヤル 〜魔王になったので世界統一を目指します〜
synonyms: Dungeon Battle Royale ~ Since I Became a Demon King, I Will Aim for World Domination ~
synopsis: One day everyone on earth suddenly receives a mysterious survey email. The mail states that the world salvation project has begun and that everyone will be divided into LAW, CHAOS and NEUTRAL. Shion Kurosaki, a loner freshman in university, was sorted into CHAOS. Which means that in the new world he is to be a Demon Lord who needs to prepare his dungeon, fill it with monsters and fend off the attacks from the LAW heroes. A dungeon building adventure begins! (Source: MangaPlaza)

title: Hime Shinjatta!
synopsis: A serial killer sets out to assassinate a luxury-loving princess. However, upon arrival, he finds her flirting with a prince!? The prince tries to protect the princess, but in the process, accidentally pushes her, causing her to hit her head and die instantly. The killer, who didn’t even have to dirty his hands, considers it an easy job—until the prince makes a shocking request…!? (Source: Shonen Jump Plus, translated)

title: Mimi's Tales of Terror
synonyms: Las historias de fantasmas de Mimi
synopsis: University student Mimi and her boyfriend Naoto encounter one chilling mystery after another. There’s the enigmatic neighbor woman dressed in black from head to toe—but if she’s so odd, why does it seems like there are many others like her? Then, whose eyes track Mimi’s movements from the cemetery next door? And why does a bizarre red circle drawn on a basement wall change with each passing day? Nine scary stories that really happened, drawn from the famed collection of urban legends Shin Mimibukuro (New Earmuffs), and adapted into manga by horror genius Junji Ito! Chapter 1: On the Utility Pole Chapter 2: The Woman Next Door Chapter 3: Rustling in the Grass Chapter 4: Grave Placement Chapter 5: Seashore Chapter 6: Just the Two of Us Chapter 7: Scarlet Circle Chapter 8: Sign in the Field Chapter 9: Monster Prop (Source: VIZ Media)

title: World End Economica
synopsis: Roughly 16 years after the people who emigrated to the Moon had settled themselves. An age where a great number of people are chasing their wild dreams within the great skyscraper at humanity's frontier. A young boy named Hal, born and raised on the Moon, is one of those people chasing his wildest dream. His dream, is to stand where no man has before. In order to do so, he needed capital. A ludicrous amount of capital. The boy named Hal was facing a place that gathered up people's desires. Sometimes it granted them, and sometimes it crushed them mercilessly. There are only two key rules that govern that land. "The first rule, is to never take a loss. The second rule, is to never forget the first." Only those who followed these rules were able to obtain enormous wealth. The stock market. A place that has gathered crowds of persistent men and women for centuries. (Source: WEE Official)

title: Puniru is a Kawaii Slime
titleNative: ぷにるはかわいいスライム
synopsis: Kotaro is an average young boy, and like many kids his age, he enjoys the latest childhood craze of playing with slime. One day, the slime randomly turns into an adorable girl who he names Puniru. Though cute, her stubbornness and constant need for attention get on his nerves. It’s like having a goopy little sister! Just when the two settle into their not-so-normal life, the granddaughter of Kyuthi Land’s founder arrives. Can Okanega Alice and her little friend Runrune out-cute the world’s most adorable slime girl?! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

synopsis: Summer 1983...Hinamizawa is a tranquil village, but its inhabitants have been plagued by strange deaths and unexplained disappearances seemingly every year. Some say it's the terrifying curse of Hinamizawa's legendary deity, Oyashiro-sama, causing victims to be spirited away by monsters, but is this town harboring dark, horrying secrets even more sinister than any supersition or myth? An epilogue to Matsuribayashi-hen where Rika and the others, including Hanyū, go on a summer vacation to heal their hearts, so to speak, after everything they have been through.
